Package index

Fitting and certifying

The entry point. A specification says what to check and what a failure means; fitting runs the checks and issues the certificate.

attest_spec() default_checks()
Build an attestation specification
attest_fit()
Fit a model and issue a certificate
split_random() split_grouped() split_temporal()
Split strategies

Inspecting a certificate

What the model attests, whether it is intact, and the model card rendered from it.

certificate() is_sealed() verify() unseal()
Inspect and verify certificates
report()
Render a model card from the certificate

Predicting

Predictions carry a value, an interval or label set, a validity status and a reason.

predict(<attested_model>)
Predict with validity status

Leakage checks

leak_duplicates()
Leakage check: exact duplicate rows across train and test
leak_target_proxy()
Leakage check: a single feature is a near-deterministic proxy of the target
leak_temporal()
Leakage check: test rows must not precede training rows in time

Calibration and coverage

Expected calibration error and split conformal coverage, the latter optionally reweighted for covariate shift.

calib_ece()
Calibration check: expected calibration error on the test set
conformal_split()
Coverage check: split conformal prediction
attest_weighted_quantile()
Weighted conformal quantile
attest_density_ratio()
Estimate a covariate density ratio between calibration and new data

Shift detection

A population stability monitor calibrated against a simulated null, and a classifier two-sample test that sees changes in dependence structure a per-feature statistic cannot.

shift_monitor()
Shift monitor: population stability index baseline
shift_c2st()
Shift check: classifier two-sample test on the prediction batch
attest_c2st()
Classifier two-sample test

Writing your own check

Checks are the extension point. The helpers are exported so a custom check can use the same interval machinery as the built-in ones.

new_check()
Define a new check
attest_result()
Create a check result
attest_boot()
Bootstrap a confidence interval for a check statistic
attest_verdict()
Decide a check verdict from an interval and a threshold
imbalance_report()
Class imbalance report (informational, never blocks)

Engines

Thin adapters around modelling functions. engine_parsnip() reaches the whole parsnip ecosystem without an adapter for each back end.

engine_glm() engine_ranger()
Engine adapters
engine_parsnip()
Fit any parsnip model under a certificate
engine_fit()
Fit a model with an engine
engine_predict()
Predict from an engine-fitted object

Audit trail

An append-only, hash-chained record of every certificate a project issues.

attest_ledger()
An append-only ledger of issued certificates
attest_manifest()
Build a portable manifest for an attested model
ledger_append()
Append a certificate to a ledger
ledger_entries()
Read the entries of a ledger
ledger_find()
Find the ledger entry for a model
ledger_verify()
Verify the integrity of a ledger chain
